- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Abstract of Reference 1: Interactivity is a key element in the gaming experience, and this study investigates the relationship between interactivity, player enjoyment, and other factors influencing player engagement. High interactivity levels contribute to increased enjoyment, satisfaction, and positive affect, ultimately building trust and loyalty among fans.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reference 2: Hamari, J., Koivisto, J., & Sarsa, H. (2014). Does gamification work? A literature review of empirical studies on gamification. In Proceedings of the 47th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences, 3025-3034.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Abstract of Reference 2: Gamification, the integration of game elements into non-game contexts, has gained popularity as a means of engaging users and enhancing their experiences. This literature review examines the effectiveness of gamification, focusing on the role of interactive elements in fostering user engagement, satisfaction, and trust.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reference 3: Vorderer, P., Klimmt, C., & Ritterfeld, U. (2004). Enjoyment: At the heart of media entertainment. Communication Theory, 14(4), 388-408.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Abstract of Reference 3: This paper proposes that enjoyment is the core concept in media entertainment, encompassing various aspects of the user experience, including interactivity. Understanding the factors that contribute to enjoyment can help comprehend how trust and engagement among fans are affected.
